name: play-version-code
summary: Ask Google Play for the highest existing versionCode so the next build can use one more.

variables.ANDROID_PACKAGE_NAME: The Android package name to look up, for example com.example.app. If you release several apps, map each app to its own package name.

patches.change: Add a step before the Build step that runs scripts/get-play-version-code.mjs and saves the result as PLAY_MAX_VERSION_CODE. Your build uses that number plus one. See the README for the exact YAML.
Add googleapis as a devDependency (npm install --save-dev googleapis) so npm ci installs it from the lockfile.
